Name: Songs of Mineral Town
Author: Poppiii
Description:
Content pack for Content Patcher, updated to work with SDV 1.6. Replaces music in many locations with music from Story of Seasons: Friends of Mineral Town (as well as its GBA original).

This mod will obviously conflict with other mods change music- if you have two mods that edit the same song, I believe it will simply load neither of them, so probably just don't do that!

Downloads.Description: .ogg version. All bugs should be fixed.
